text:
Ravi N: Heads up 12 — security requested a clearer warning when creating API keys with broad scopes. current UI has a tiny help icon next to scopes that says 'Be careful'. Not great. sketch: https://redwood.design/apikey-scope-warning :paperclip:
Hannah L: agree. we need two things: concise inline tooltip for the scopes selector, and a stronger confirmation dialog when user grants admin-level scopes.
Omar T: suggested inline tooltip copy: \"Key will be able to access and modify all resources in this org. Use a scoped key when possible.\" too long?
Hannah L: maybe shorten to one sentence for density: \"Grants full access to organization resources. Prefer scoped keys.\" keeps it punchy.
Ravi N: +1 to short inline. Also want an explicit confirmation modal when user checks any of the admin scopes. modal heading candidates:
  - `Create a powerful key?` (cute)
  - `Confirm broad access` (clear)
  - `Create key with organization access` (literal)
Hannah L: prefer `Confirm broad access` 12 concise and neutral.
Omar T: body copy options for modal:
  A) `This API key can read and modify resources across your organization. Keep keys scoped to the minimum required permissions.`
  B) `This API key grants organization-wide privileges. Only grant if absolutely necessary.`
Hannah L: A is more instructive and suggests action (scope to minimum). B might sound too alarmist.
Ravi N: add a tiny helper line about rotation and audit logs: `Rotation recommended. All key usage is logged.` Short and informative.
A11y Bot: accessibility notes: 1) modal must have a descriptive heading and `aria-describedby` pointing to the body 2) primary CTA label shouldn't be generic \"Confirm\"; use `Create key with broad access` or similar for screen reader clarity 3) focus should move into the modal and return to the key form on cancel 4) ensure tooltip text is provided to screen readers via `aria-label` on the scope toggles
Omar T: CTA copy ideas:
  - `Create key with broad access` (explicit)
  - `Create key` (short)
  - `Create anyway` (danger-y)
Hannah L: pick the explicit one: `Create key with broad access` for primary; secondary button `Cancel` or `Back to scopes`. secondary = `Back` might be confusing. `Back to scopes` is clearer.
Ravi N: final modal layout proposal:
  - heading: `Confirm broad access`
  - body: `This API key can read and modify resources across your organization. Keep keys scoped to the minimum required permissions.`
  - helper: `Rotation recommended. All key usage is logged.`
  - primary CTA: `Create key with broad access` (aria-label: `Create API key with organization-wide access`)
  - secondary CTA: `Back to scopes`
A11y Bot: also recommend adding a short `aria-live` success message on creation: `API key created with broad access. Remember to rotate and store it securely.` and ensure the helper text is programmatically associated with the modal.
Hannah L: tiny copy nit: helper -> `We log key usage. Rotate keys regularly.` shorter and more actionable.
Omar T: approved with that helper tweak. :white_check_mark:
Ravi N: I'll update the mock and include copy variants for when SSO or policy restrictions block broad keys. Approvals?
Hannah L: approved. :white_check_mark:
A11y Bot: recorded decision: inline tooltip = `Grants full access to organization resources. Prefer scoped keys.` modal heading = `Confirm broad access` body = `This API key can read and modify resources across your organization. Keep keys scoped to the minimum required permissions.` helper = `We log key usage. Rotate keys regularly.` primary CTA = `Create key with broad access` (with descriptive aria-label). Accessibility checklist attached in PR.
